findings.evidence: `Corestrict.lean`: `corestrictCoact f := TensorProduct.map LinearMap.id f.toLinearMap ∘ₗ coact`; `Hopf/Map.lean:79-80`: `mapDomain_apply ... = toConv (f.ofConv.comp (φ : H₁ →ₐ[R] H₂))`; `PointsAction.lean:86-90` leaves exactly that goal after `rw [LinearMap.lTensor_comp, LinearMap.comp_apply]`.
findings.fix: Rewrite explicitly instead: add/use a lemma identifying `(φ : H₁ →ₐ[R] H₂).toLinearMap` with `φ.toCoalgHom.toLinearMap`, and turn `lTensor` into `TensorProduct.map LinearMap.id` (or vice versa) by a named rewrite, so no step depends on unfolding. If a `rfl` is genuinely unavoidable, document exactly which defeq it uses.
findings.issue: `endOfPoint_corestrict` closes with a bare, uncommented `rfl`. The residual goal is `TensorProduct.map LinearMap.id φ.toCoalgHom.toLinearMap x = LinearMap.lTensor V (↑φ : H₁ →ₐ[R] H₂).toLinearMap x`: it holds only by delta-unfolding `LinearMap.lTensor` to `TensorProduct.map LinearMap.id` and by the accidental agreement of two coercion paths out of the same `BialgHom` (`toCoalgHom.toLinearMap` vs `toAlgHom.toLinearMap`), plus a `toConv`/`ofConv` round trip.

findings.evidence: `SemisimplePoint.lean:95-97` and `Naturality.lean:74-77`; the `letI`-in-statement form is `PointsAction.lean:101-104`. `Finite/Corestrict.lean` already provides explicit bridging lemmas (`corestrict_obj_coact`, `corestrict_obj_coe`), so the pattern of naming these identifications is established.
findings.fix: Add a bundled-object form of the compatibility next to the FG corestriction API, e.g. `Comodule.pointsAction ((FGComoduleCat.corestrict f).obj M) g = Comodule.pointsAction M (AlgHom.mapDomain φ g)`, and rewrite with that at both sites instead of relying on `exact`-level defeq through the `letI` statement.
findings.issue: After `rw [← Comodule.pointsAction_corestrict (V := M) φ g]` the goal carries the `letI`-bound `Comodule.Corestrict φ.toCoalgHom` instance on the bare carrier `↑M`, while `hg ((FGComoduleCat.corestrict φ.toCoalgHom).obj M)` supplies the instance packaged inside the bundled object; `exact` silently identifies them by defeq, with no lemma and no comment. Same pattern at `JordanDecomposition/Naturality.lean:75-77` (`isUnipotent_pointsAction_unipotentPart ... ((FGComoduleCat.corestrict φ.toCoalgHom).obj M)`).

findings.evidence: `Naturality.lean:85-88, 94-97`; `AlgHom.mapDomain_apply` is `rfl` (`Hopf/Map.lean:79-80`), so the two forms are the same term written unfolded.
findings.fix: State both with `AlgHom.mapDomain φ g` / `AlgHom.mapDomain φ (semisimplePart k H₂ K g)`; the proof then reduces to `congrArg Prod.fst (jordanDecomposition_mapDomain φ g)` (resp. `Prod.snd`) modulo `jordanDecomposition_fst`/`_snd`, with no unfolding step.
findings.issue: `semisimplePart_mapDomain` and `unipotentPart_mapDomain` (line 94) state the point as `toConv (g.ofConv.comp (φ : H₁ →ₐ[k] H₂))` rather than `AlgHom.mapDomain φ g`, so the proofs need `simpa only [..., AlgHom.mapDomain_apply]` purely to unfold the definition the lemma names.

summary: Three of the new proofs are closed by undocumented definitional equality across coercion paths and comodule-instance wrappers: a bare `rfl` in `endOfPoint_corestrict`, and two `exact`s that silently identify a `letI`-bound `Corestrict` instance with the instance carried by the bundled `FGComoduleCat` object. The two component lemmas also state `mapDomain` in unfolded form, forcing a `simpa only` bridge.
